source_evidence: Investors buy and sell ETF shares on national stock exchanges and at market prices that may or may not be the same as the NAV of the shares.
question: When investors trade ETF shares on an exchange, will the trading price always equal the ETF’s net asset value (NAV)?
answer: No. ETF shares trade at market prices, which may be higher or lower than the ETF’s NAV. This means buyers may pay more or less than NAV, and sellers may receive more or less than NAV.
